_comment_baseline_format: Optional regression-tracking sidecar to absolute thresholds. Each scenario's most recent good run can be committed here; runAll.mjs warns when a metric drifts > 20% from the baseline (still PASS-level, but regressing). Update the file from a run on a representative machine, NOT from CI ephemeral runners.
_comment_how_to_update: On a quiet local machine: `pnpm load:all > /tmp/load.json`, then copy the relevant fields from each scenario's parsed result into baselines.json (rename _example to baselines.json).
_comment_tolerance: Default ±20% drift allowed silently. Set _toleranceFactor on a per-metric override to tighten/loosen.
